pages.lines:
RV Sites
Our full hookup RV sites offer individually metered electric, water, and sewer connections for nightly, weekly, monthly, or seasonal stays. Spacious sites make it easy to settle in, whether you're passing through or staying all season.
View RV Sites
Tent Sites
Our no-hookup tent sites offer a quiet, rustic camping experience close to our pool, playground, and hiking trails. Nightly rates make it easy to plan a short getaway in Darlington, PA.
View Tent Sites

pages.title: https://crawfordscampground.com/rates | RV & Tent Site Rates and Fees | Crawford's Camping Park
pages.lines:
Rates
Nightly, weekly, monthly, and seasonal rates for RV and tent camping in Darlington, PA
Nightly	$50 + electric
Weekly	$225 + electric
Monthly
$50 refundable deposit required. Monthly campers may live in their campers 24/7 and are restricted to two (2) vehicles per site.	$650 + electric
Seasonal
Seasonal campers may stay weekends, vacations, and holidays, but may not live in their unit. There is a 115 day per season limit. The seasonal fee includes water and sewer.	$1,850 + electric
Winter
We have a limited number of winterized sites available by the month or season.	Call for rates
Tent Nightly (No Hookups)	$40
Shelter Rental	Call for rates
Camping Policies
Primitive tent sites $40 per night. Weekly/monthly tent rates are not available. Your tent must be moved if you camp longer than 4 days.
Electric
